utfall: reduksjon i varighet av ledighet med dagpenger (uker) ved bonus, for de med rett til 38 uker
sammenligning: bonus på 500 dollar mot kontroll, rett til 38 uker
sitat: the Claimant Bonus treatment--an offer of $500 in cash for rapid reemployment--reduced the duration of insured unemployment by about 1.8 weeks for workers who were eligible for 38 weeks of UI benefits, but by only about 0.75 week for the workers who were eligible for 26 weeks of UI.
